'''Hacina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witch]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. She belonged to the [[Red Mud Potters Clan]] though she was also secretly a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].

==Biography==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], during the annual [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|meeting]] of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] and the [[Broken Columns Clan]], Hacina was part of a group of Nightsisters that tried to sabotage the two clan's union. The Nightsisters sent a large swarm of [[Sparkfly/Legends|sparkflies]] against the Raining Leaves and Broken Columns, but [[Carrack]], one of the guides hired by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], fired a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] in Hacina's position. Hacina and another unidentified Nightsister perished from the grenade blast.<ref name="backlash" />
